The dish looks like hash browns or shredded potatoes topped with salsa verde and pico de gallo. The potato layer is fairly thin, so I estimate about 150 g of potatoes plus roughly 40 g of salsa, for a total of about 190 g.

Fried shredded potato runs about 1.5 kcal/g, which gives about 225 kcal for the potatoes. The salsa adds about 20 kcal, so the total is roughly 250 kcal.
